admission.justification: A false loaded=false answer can hide the wrong-server hazard and remove the only protective instruction.

applicability: Role-start and leaf-seat-set answers and compiled first messages.
conditions: Derive secondCopyLoaded independently for each agent from its actual launch receipt.
Keep the task-server instruction when no supported exclusion was applied.
exclusions: Harness name alone is not evidence of suppression.
Unreadable or mismatched receipts cannot be treated as proof that the ambient copy is absent.

evidence: the three tests named in found_at; notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/260928-MIK-L113-worker-a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d.md, section 3

statement: The role start's answer says for each agent whether a second copy is loaded, derived from the exclusion record of that launch; the first message keeps the sentence on which of the two servers to use only where the copy is not kept out.
